requirements.title: Linux-first desktop
requirements.requirement: Launch and operate on the recorded Arch/Hyprland environment, with capability fallbacks.

requirements.title: Audited requested template
requirements.requirement: Use agmmnn/tauri-ui Vite/React scaffold; remove unrequested sample functionality.

requirements.title: Complete selected discovery
requirements.requirement: Enumerate every API page for owned/selected repositories; include forks/private/archived when granted.

requirements.title: GitLab backup mapping
requirements.requirement: Preview one source-to-one destination project mapping in an owner-chosen namespace.

requirements.title: Managed local storage
requirements.requirement: Choose and validate a local root; maintain app-owned bare mirrors separately from workspaces.

requirements.title: One-way authority
requirements.requirement: No GitHub writes or merging of GitLab/local changes into GitHub.

requirements.title: All-ref change detection
requirements.requirement: Compare complete selected heads/tags, not only timestamps or default HEAD.

requirements.title: Fresh and honest status
requirements.requirement: Expose observation times and unknown/stale/partial coverage without false healthy labels.

requirements.title: Scheduled and manual jobs
requirements.requirement: Provide scan/sync queue, retry, cancellation and bounded concurrency.

requirements.title: Crash recovery
requirements.requirement: Persist jobs and reconcile uncertain outcomes after restart.

requirements.title: PAT authentication
requirements.requirement: Connect GitHub and GitLab through validated PATs; no fake OAuth.

requirements.title: Secret storage
requirements.requirement: Use OS keyring or explicit session-only storage; never plaintext fallback.

requirements.title: Narrow native boundary
requirements.requirement: Allowlisted typed commands, native validation, least-privilege capabilities.

requirements.title: Redacted activity
requirements.requirement: Useful bounded activity/logs and explicit redacted export.

requirements.title: LFS coverage
requirements.requirement: Transfer selected reachable LFS payloads and report upload vs restore verification separately.

requirements.title: Submodule transparency
requirements.requirement: Preserve gitlinks and state child backup coverage; no blind recursive clone.

requirements.title: Workspace safety
requirements.requirement: Optional workspace updates never overwrite dirty, ahead, detached or diverged work.

requirements.title: Historical recovery
requirements.requirement: Verified snapshots before destructive changes and a tested restore runbook.

requirements.title: Failure management
requirements.requirement: Classified retries, rate-limit waits, timeout and process-tree cleanup.

requirements.title: Plan-bound writes
requirements.requirement: Exact-ref plans and leases; invalidate approval on source/destination/policy drift.

requirements.title: Deletion safeguards
requirements.requirement: No backup deletion from incomplete discovery, access failure or missing source repo.

requirements.title: Untrusted-input defense
requirements.requirement: Validate paths/refs/URLs, disallow hooks and hostile Git configuration.

requirements.title: UI visual fidelity
requirements.requirement: Match reviewed Refined V2 plus corrections using genuine baselines and visual evidence.

requirements.title: Semantic icons
requirements.requirement: Replace status dots/text placeholders with valid consistent icons and accessible labels.

requirements.title: Balanced clean UI
requirements.requirement: No card/chart spam or sparse wireframe substitute; retain decision-relevant information.

requirements.title: Usable adaptive UI
requirements.requirement: Keyboard, focus, resizing, zoom, error/loading states without overlap or clipping.

requirements.title: Onboarding
requirements.requirement: Folder, credentials, repository/destination review and initial scan progress.

requirements.title: Dashboard
requirements.requirement: Derived totals, attention items, backup pipeline and recent activity.

requirements.title: Repository management
requirements.requirement: Search/filter/select and per-repo/bulk actions using stable IDs.

requirements.title: Repository details
requirements.requirement: Overview, selected ref comparison, history, logs and coverage.

requirements.title: Sync center
requirements.requirement: Queue and selected job stages; no default console wall or fake ETA.

requirements.title: Activity screen
requirements.requirement: Searchable timeline with optional sanitized event detail.

requirements.title: Connections screen
requirements.requirement: Account, access/credential status, destination namespace, folder and safe disconnect.

requirements.title: Settings screen
requirements.requirement: Typed, validated policies with explicit save and truthful capability availability.

requirements.title: Focused dialogs
requirements.requirement: Distinct empty/error/warning/confirm states with a clear safe next action.

requirements.title: Contract parity
requirements.requirement: Native DTOs, FE validators and fixtures agree on version, casing and error codes.

requirements.title: Evidence-driven implementation
requirements.requirement: No invented APIs, production fakes or unexecuted-test success claims.

requirements.title: Verified Linux package
requirements.requirement: Build/install/run smoke test on a clean supported native environment.

requirements.title: No telemetry
requirements.requirement: No analytics or template debug-panel leakage in release builds.

requirements.title: Stable identities
requirements.requirement: Handle rename/transfer/case/path collision without duplicating or overwriting unrelated repos.

requirements.title: Provider limits and permissions
requirements.requirement: Show partial scope, forbidden resources and rate limits without guessing token capability.

requirements.title: Scoped backup verification
requirements.requirement: Git refs, local objects, LFS, submodules and workspace statuses are independent.

requirements.title: Consistent summaries
requirements.requirement: Derive card/table/detail statuses from the same snapshot and revision.

requirements.title: Lifecycle and tray fallback
requirements.requirement: Closing vs quitting is explicit; no invisible unrecoverable background process.

requirements.title: Safe Git credential bridge
requirements.requirement: No credentials in CLI argv, env or URLs; bind helper requests to account/job/origin/path.
